purpose: Bind high-detail danchi manufacture microstructure to metric UV0 coordinates and deterministic per-piece cut-origin phase diversity without awarding Visual Fidelity points before native render evidence.

uvPolicy.boxProjection: Per-face orthonormal tangent projection in local manufactured dimensions; V follows the longest available component axis so directional extrusion grain runs along the member rather than across it.
uvPolicy.cylinderProjection: Axial coordinate is physical local-Y metres. Circumference is mapped near-metrically and adjusted to the nearest whole texture repeat so the wrap seam closes without a phase jump; planar end caps remain metric local-X/Z.
uvPolicy.phaseSource: Deterministic FNV-1a hash of the source renderer hierarchy path.
uvPolicy.phaseReasoning: Repeated balcony/window/fastener parts are separate manufactured pieces cut from stock or formed independently; a deterministic cut-origin phase prevents every apartment module from restarting the same microscopic patch while remaining stable across rebuilds.

materials.physicalInterpretation: Extrusion-scale normal grain becomes sub-millimetre-to-millimetre response within a roughly 71 mm repeat field; phase differs by manufactured member while the long-axis direction is preserved.
Broad zinc/oxidation mottling repeats on roughly 91 mm fields while bolts and brackets retain individually phased stock origins.
Fine dielectric EPDM grain uses a roughly 56 mm repeat field; gasket length remains geometry while only surface grain is tiled.
Injection-mould orange peel uses a roughly 83 mm repeat field; casing form and panel breaks remain geometry.
Wrap-skin relief uses a 125 mm repeat field while pipe routing, bends and collars remain modeled geometry.
Axial hose rib signal resolves to approximately 5 mm cadence inside a roughly 143 mm texture repeat; circumference wrap is closed to an integer repeat to avoid a normal-map seam.

reviewFor: obvious synchronized phase across repeated apartment modules
texture scale changing with component dimensions
moire, shimmer or unstable grazing highlights

limitations: Metric UVs and deterministic phase diversity are source/runtime geometry properties; they cannot prove that repeated patterns are visually imperceptible in the final camera framing.

Small cylindrical hardware may deviate from exact circumferential texel density because seam closure deliberately rounds the circumference to a whole texture repeat; the maximum error is bounded by half one texture repeat and must be judged in native pixels.
The generated maps remain procedural approximations of manufacture microstructure rather than scanned material measurements; actual BRDF/Fresnel response remains a native-render judgment.
No Visual Fidelity score is awarded until the 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing frames and 100% crops exist and pass the canonical gate.
